Shesim apartament 1+1 ne Paskuqan te Kompleksi Aluna.
Ndodhte ne Katin e pare banim, kati 3 teknik, te nje prej kullave me pamje nga Bulevardi Ri.
Organizohet ne nje sallon dhe kuzhine, nje dhome gjumi, nje tualet, nje ballkon
Orientohet jug-perendim.
Proces ndertimi ne faze tull-rifinitura
description_en: We are selling a 1+1 apartment in Paskuqan, Complex Aluna. It was located on the first residential floor, 3rd technical floor, of one of the towers overlooking the Ri Boulevard. It is organized in a living room and kitchen, a bedroom, a toilet, a balcony. It is oriented south-west. Construction process in the brick-refinished phase
